desc: After ticket 215 passes, install and verify the reproducible Alpine SD-root daily-v2 object. Exercise its read-only hardware/card/image/filesystem identity gates, early ttydc0 console, OpenRC boot, panel+i3, WiFi/BT firmware loaded before switch_root, and PID-1 shutdown pivot; then use the repair image in check-only mode to prove exFAT and ext4 remained clean. The daily DT deliberately disables ANS/NVMe to avoid the known CQ-wrap assert and disables system-PMU SPMI plus macsmc RTC/reboot under the current SPMI policy. Filesystems must unmount cleanly; the final hardware reboot/poweroff remains a separately reviewed blocker and may no-op.
author: sol
bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel console=ttydc0 rdinit=/init
pass: SD64, image size, ext4 UUID, and clean-state gates pass; ttydc0 precedes OpenRC; panel+i3 and WiFi/BT return; shutdown unmounts ext4 and exFAT and detaches the loop; postcheck is clean without repair. Final reset may no-op because the PMU-backed reboot node is intentionally disabled.
stop: Any dirty or identity gate, hash mismatch, mount/pivot/unmount failure, repair request, PCIe/DART/kernel fault, or lost console.
review_blocker: Blocked on ticket 215 and independent exact review of object bdd8cc865081a2041e587d1bb30495ca0bb65da305552dd4b6679cba66c5f5a5: DTB disabled-node gates, paired firmware manifest, shutdown mount topology, PID-1 SIGQUIT/restart path, embedded scripts, userspace payload, and strict complete-object verification. The maintainer will separately create the third boot partition and install the object after review.
